title: Every team's championship odds for the 2026 World Cup: Favorites France, Spain to meet in semis - ESPN
text:
The 2026 FIFA World Cup is down to its final four teams, and France and Spain remain atop the World Cup winner odds board. The French, who secured the first semifinals berth on Thursday with a win over Morocco, have taken control as the clear favorites, moving to +150 from +500 at the start of the festivities.

The Spanish, meanwhile, have improved to +310 from +450 at the start of the tournament and will face France on Tuesday after advancing to the semifinals with a win over Belgium (32-1) on Friday.

England currently stands at +340 to win the tournament while their semifinal opponent Argentina is at +360 ahead of Wednesday's match. England defeated Norway in extra time on Saturday thanks to a brace from Jude Bellingham, while Argentina clutched a late win against Switzerland, who were reduced to 10 men.

The United States was easily the largest liability for every major American sportsbook, so their elimination at the hands of the Belgians in the Round of 16 was already a win. Bookmakers at BetMGM and Caesars told ESPN they are now turning their attention to France, which has attracted attention from bettors since the tournament began and at longer prices since the market opened four years ago.

Odds subject to change. See DK Sports  for more.
